artifacts.summary: 13-phase incremental migration plan bundling Duration as a TaskFrame field behind a definitional ParamTaskFrame bridge, with lake build green at every phase boundary.

memory_candidates.content: Refactoring a widely-used Lean 4 structure from parameterized to bundled form (a type parameter becoming a field) is migratable incrementally rather than big-bang when the two forms are related by a definitional isomorphism: rename the old structure to Param<X>, declare the bundled X beside it, and bridge with ofParam/toParam, which round-trip by rfl in both directions via structure eta. Downstream files then migrate one import layer at a time with the build green at every step, and the bridge is deleted last. Two mechanics make this work in practice: (1) declare ofParam @[reducible] or as an abbrev, because typeclass synthesis runs at reducible transparency and a plain def in the chain stalls it, manufacturing a transitional instance diamond between the bundled projection and the ambient instance binder; (2) at CONCRETE carrier values the same transparency split means numerals cannot elaborate at F.Carrier and omega cannot recognize the type even though F.Carrier = Int is rfl at default transparency -- state concrete-carrier lemmas with explicit (d : Int) binders and discharge arithmetic outside the structure application. Abstract-carrier code is entirely unaffected.
